result.summary: TEST-DESIGNER, REQ-511 / GH #2682 PR a. Wrote 149 new tests in 7 files plus a spec, and fixed 4 existing test files (tests only; lib/ and priv/ untouched at the end, verified with git diff after every mutant). RESULT: 148/149 new tests pass; 1 FAILS ON PURPOSE and exposes an IMPLEMENTATION BUG (reported, not fixed, per instruction): Letflow.Modules.Exam.Snapshot.Rollout refuses (status :failed, error {:definition_write_failed, :unsupported_definition_value}, nothing written) any tenant whose active session definition stores an optional field key as JSON null, e.g. search_strategy: null (optional_atom_value/3 maps a present-but-nil key through the @strategies whitelist). Definitions.create_definition/2 stores exactly that shape for every field built from a Definition map, so every ExamFixtures/ExamStampFixtures tenant and plausibly the hand-posted QA/BilimBaga rows are affected; the rollout would fail on them. Failing test: snapshot_rollout_test.exs 'REPRO: a stored definition whose optional field keys are JSON null'. All other rollout tests use ExamFixtures.downgrade_session_definition_without_nils! and pass (diff-by-exactly-one-field, no DDL on a column-promoted tenant, idempotency). RUNS (MIX_ENV=test mix test --warnings-as-errors, one mix process at a time under the mutex, free memory 4.09-5.02 GB; mutex created and removed by me): snapshot_test 46 passed; session_snapshot_test 35 (34 passed in a full run 'Result: 34 passed', 90.6 s; the 35th, the R6 query-count test, passed in a targeted run 'Result: 1 passed'); snapshot_restrictions_test 18 passed; exam_snapshot_router_test 8 passed; exam_snapshot_leak_test 10 passed; stamp_snapshot_gate_test 14 passed; snapshot_rollout_test 17/18 passed. Final combined re-run after mix format: 'Result: 113/114 passed' (the 114 = the six non-session files; the one failure is the REPRO). Existing affected files, all green after the test edits: session_test+anti_cheat+on_install+entity_definitions 'Result: 97 passed'; exam_sessions+certificate+pack_install+exam_stamped_tenant 'Result: 55 passed'; stamp+stamp_trigger+tamper_inventory 'Result: 44 passed'; exam_managed_types_http+bilimbaga_solution_e2e+seed.exam_fixtures 'Result: 17 passed'; squat_remediation+entities_answer_key_field_leak+solution_packs_module_owned_pack+exam_managed_manifest+exam_definitions+scoring+entities_query_restricted_filter 'Result: 118 passed'; client_key_namespace 'Result: 38 passed'. mix format --check-formatted over every touched test file: exit 0. MUTANTS (applied to the shipped file, targeted tests run, file restored from a byte copy, git diff -- lib priv config empty each time): P0/M1 whole pre-change session.ex from 828d9d1be -> 27/34 failed in session_snapshot_test (7 passers are by-design controls T-12, T-14, T-43, T-45, T-46, the R6 ownership test and the first form of T-13; T-13 was then rewritten to discriminate and fails alone on the old code); M2 default 60.0 -> 7/24 failed; M3 submit rebuilds without exam_snapshot -> 3/15 failed (T-04, T-14, T-47); M5 drop the session.exam_snapshot pair -> 16/19 failed; M7 Stamp ignores the flag -> 6/14 failed; M8 skip digest verification -> 2/14 failed (T-18 x2); M10 autosave/state read live type -> 2/15 failed (T-06, T-07); M13 create without exam_snapshot -> 23/23 failed; M15 terminal state read fails on missing snapshot -> 3/4 failed (T-43, T-45, T-46). NOT RUN: mix letflow.check.test (it runs the full suite, which this step was told never to run); substitute: all run logs grepped for 'default values for the optional arguments' = 0 hits and no compiler warnings in the new files. Lock-timeout path of the rollout and the System.halt(1) branches of the two Mix tasks cannot run in-process (source-guarded; the stamp task's dry-run path and the rollout task's usage/dry-run paths are executed). PR b tests (T-09..T-11, T-21..T-25, T-38..T-40, T-44, T-48..T-52, T-58..T-63b, T-20b, T-55c, T-57b, M4/M9/M11/M12/M14/M16) are deliberately not written. UPDATE after TDV: added the unknown-key/unsupported-value refusal test, the null-drop field-survival diff assertion, and real_queries > 0 (non-vacuity); rollout T-37 + R6 describes: Result: 9 passed, 45 excluded; format clean; lib untouched. The earlier rollout bug is fixed in lib (1e0a9e18f), so the REPRO test now passes.

issues.description: OBSERVATION (pre-existing, not caused by PR a): Latest.get/3 and Session.query_all/3 return soft-deleted rows (deleted: true). A deleted answer_option is still listed by the state read and still counted when the snapshot is built; a manual pin to a soft-deleted question whose status is still 'active' is accepted at start. Design 3.4 states a deleted option disappears from the rendered options; the code shows it does not. The T-13 deleted-option half is therefore a no-crash control that also passes on the old code; the added-option half discriminates.

Rollout status :managed_cannot_upgrade is unreachable through supported means in PR a (the stamp rejects a session definition without exam_snapshot as shape_not_compatible), and the stamp-GUC tripwire scan forbids a test from planting it, so it has no test. Rollout :lock_timeout and the two Mix tasks' System.halt(1) branches are source-guarded only.
